title: A shipment is held at customs
summary: A fact-led response for establishing the hold reason, gathering documents and escalating only with the relevant shipment record intact.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when a carrier, broker or customs authority indicates that a shipment is being held, delayed for documentation or awaiting clarification.
immediateAction: Confirm the shipment reference, current carrier status and stated reason for the hold.
Gather the commercial invoice, packing information and any already-issued shipment documentation without creating replacement documents casually.
Identify who is formally requesting information and respond through the established carrier/broker channel.

whoToInform.when: Immediately once a hold is confirmed.
The hold threatens a launch/production milestone or requires an exceptional financial/commercial decision.

whatToRecord: Deadlines, fees or milestone impact communicated
escalationConditions: The reason for hold is unclear or contradictory.
Additional charges, return/destruction risk or legal/compliance questions arise.
The delivery delay affects a critical sample, production or launch milestone.

templatesResources.label: Shipment incident note
templatesResources.text: Keep the carrier status, request, documents sent, timestamps and next expected update in one continuous record.
